newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish debt/currency market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swedish debt/currency market closing report.

text.p: Swedish debt yields closed mixed with T-bills supported by yesterday's 25 basis point repo rate cut and bonds suffering from higher foreign debt yields and weak demand at today's bond auction.
The National Debt Office's issue of 2 billion crowns in 10-year bonds attracted just 2.3 billion in bids with 37 of 46 bidders awarded.
"Frankly, it was a bad auction. I think yesterday's rate cut may inspire investors to go for shorter maturities," said one dealer.
On Tuesday the central bank cut the repo rate to 4.35 pct.
